name: Adrian Martikov
title: Davian's Eldest
summary: Davian's eldest son and the better vintner, though his father would sooner drink vinegar than say so. Quiet, dry, and carrying his younger brother's death like a stone in his coat. He was the raven on the Svalich road.

guest_build.note: Comes along for the climb up Yester Hill if the party lets him, and goes home after.
